Belief in God by Gender: Student Survey Results


This dataset records the self-reported belief in God of university students, including their gender and name. The data supports analysis of differences and associations between gender and religious belief, using both visual and statistical methods.

A3 - Weekly Expenditure Patterns by Gender Among Students


This dataset records weekly expenditure amounts reported by university students, including their gender and name. It enables visualization and comparison of spending patterns by gender, highlighting differences in central tendency, spread, and potential outliers. The dataset supports both descriptive and inferential statistical analyses targeting group financial behaviors.





Jashith S Kumar












A3 - Are Srishti Dads Weird?


This dataset records the responses of 65 university students from two colleges (MIT and Srishti/SMI) to a survey asking whether they believe their dads are weird. For each student, the dataset captures their gender, college affiliation, unique name, and a Yes/No response to the question “Is your dad weird?” The data is strictly categorical, enabling comparison of perceived dad weirdness across gender and institutional groupings.





Jashith S Kumar

title: A3 - Weekly Expenditure Patterns by Gender Among Students
section: plotting a histogram to show expenditure habits by gender
text:
plotting a histogram to show expenditure habits by gender

ggplot(spend_modified, aes(x = total_expenditure_last_week, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ gender, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Expenditure Histogram by Gender",
       x = "Total Expenditure Last Week",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

title: A3 - Weekly Expenditure Patterns by Gender Among Students
section: Plotting mean weekly expenditure differs by gender
text:
Plotting mean weekly expenditure differs by gender

means <- spend_modified %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_expenditure = mean(total_expenditure_last_week, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot bar graph of means by gender
ggplot(means, aes(x = gender, y = mean_expenditure, fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Mean Weekly Expenditure by Gender",
       x = "Gender",
       y = "Mean Expenditure") +
  theme_minimal()

bar chart of Belief in god by gender

mosaic(tab, shade = TRUE, legend = TRUE,
       labeling_args = list(
         set_varnames = c(Gender = "Gender", Belief = "Belief in God"),
         rot_labels = c(left = 0, top = 0)
       ),
       main = "Belief in God by Gender (Mosaic Plot)")
